entities.name: Skyshroud Forest
entities.description: A dense forest in Keld on Icehaven, transferred to Dominaria from Rath during the Rathi Overlay.

entities.name: Keld
entities.description: Region of Dominaria on the island of Icehaven.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: Plane to which the elves' floating construct was dragged.

entities.name: Skyshroud elves
entities.description: Once peaceable elves who built the Skyshroud forest.

entities.name: Merfolk of Rootwater
entities.description: Merfolk who shared a nation with the elves and later became savage carnivores.

entities.name: Rootwater
entities.description: The waters beneath Skyshroud, home of the merfolk.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: Planeswalker who saved the forest from freezing and later sacrificed herself to close the rift.

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: Being whose withdrawal of magic froze the forest and who was killed by the Mirari-sword.

entities.name: Rathi Overlay
entities.description: Event that brought Skyshroud to Dominaria.

entities.name: Time Spiral crisis
entities.description: Crisis during which slivers overran the forest and a time-rift opened.

entities.name: Gathans
entities.description: Time-displaced warriors from an alternate older Keld.

events.summary: The elves build the new forest Skyshroud after their alliance with the merfolk ends in a bloody battle.
events.quote: their partnership ended abruptly in a bloody battle.

events.summary: Skyshroud arrives on the frozen wastes of Keld and Freyalise casts a spell to keep it warm.
events.quote: it was saved by the planeswalker Freyalise , who cast a spell to keep the forest warm.

events.summary: Karona withdraws magic, freezing the forest for three months until Karona is killed by the Mirari-sword and it thaws.
events.quote: The forest thawed, and warmth returned.

events.summary: The slivers overrun the forest and a time-rift links Keld to its alternate older version, and Gathan warriors attack.
events.quote: Soon, these time-displaced warriors attacked the true Keldons and Skyshroud's inhabitants.

events.summary: Freyalise sacrifices herself to close the rift and the inhabitants must leave the weakened forest.
events.quote: After Freyalise sacrificed herself to close the rift

relations.quote: it was saved by the planeswalker Freyalise
The merfolk cursed the elves and their new home, named Rootwater .
Skyshroud Forest is a dense forest in Keld on the island of Icehaven
